stories.desc: Black holes, despite their extreme nature, are described by surprisingly few basic parameters: their mass, charge and spin. stories.title: Francis Halzen wins Nobel Prize in physics for work on mysterious ghost particles called neutrinos
stories.desc: Francis Halzen won the Nobel Prize in physics on Tuesday for his efforts to demystify a rare group of neutrinos, tiny cosmic particles that scientists believe offer clues to how the universe evolved.

stories.title: Nobel winner Halzen says years of October 'misery' finally over
stories.desc: Physicist Francis Halzen has an impressively long list of academic accolades—but every October, as the Nobel Prize rolled around, his failure to bag the biggest award of them all left him "miserable," he admits.
